'''Can''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] who served the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Can participated in a [[Battle of Lanteeb|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] with the goal of aiding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and destroying a Separatist [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].

==Biography==
[[File:Droid_Starfighters.png|thumb|right|250px|Can engaged in starfighter combat with vulture droids (examples pictured).]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="db" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="Siege" /> Can was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="db" /> and served as a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] to fight the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Siege" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Gold Squadron, including Can participated in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] above the planet [[Lanteeb]] as part of a [[Battle of Lanteeb|mission]] to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who were trapped behind enemy lines and to destroy the Separatists' [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]]. Flying as [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fireball (clone trooper)|Fireball's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], the two [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] feigned an attack on Jedi Master [[Taria Damsin]] who was flying a Separatist [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to trick the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] into allowing her safe passage to the planet's surface. Instead of focusing on Damsin, the [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] charged Fireball and Can, however the clones were able to gain the upper hand and destroy [[Droid/Legends|droid]] after droid, with the battle ultimately ending in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] victory.<ref name="Siege" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, Can was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Skills and abilities==
Can was a skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
Can appeared in the [[2010]] novel ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]'', written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Siege" />
